findings: learner.components[1]: Replace “It may depict a pig or represent 豭 as a sound element” with a plain-language distinction between the competing analyses: some read the lower form as a pig in a roof-and-livestock scene; the traditional account treats it as an abbreviation of 豭 because their readings match.
